<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

content.content:
1	# 网格世界：grid、table、列表与数学布局
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 解释 **轨道（track）** 的数据模型：`Sizing` 的三种形态（`auto` / 固定或相对长度 / `fr`）如何在 `CellGrid` 中统一成带 gutter 的轨道序列，`table` 为什么和 `grid` 共用同一台布局引擎。
8	2. 讲清 **轨道尺寸协商** 的完整顺序：固定轨道先解析 → `auto` 轨道用试探布局测量 → 剩余空间按比例分给 `fr` 轨道（或空间不足时让 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」），并能手工推算一张表格的列宽。
9	3. 描述 `lists.rs` 列表布局的 **架构演进**：它曾经真的复用网格引擎（`CellGrid` + `GridLayouter`），2026 年 5 月起改为专用的 `ListLayouter` + 栈布局，理解这次替换背后的动机（基线对齐）。
10	4. 了解数学排版如何组织 **符号行与嵌套结构**：`MathItem` 中间表示 → `MathFragment` 片段流 → `MathRun` 行装配，以及分数与根式如何用字体 MATH 表常量逐块拼装并对齐基线。
11	
12	本讲是第四单元「排版管线」的倒数第二讲：u4-l4 讲了 flow 如何把块级内容分配进 region，u4-l5 讲了行内断行；本讲看两个「二维」的特化布局器——网格与数学公式，它们都建立在前面的 region 协商机制之上。
13	
14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	- **`Abs` / `Rel` / `Fr`**：`Abs` 是绝对长度（pt）；`Rel` 是「比例 × 基准 + 绝对部分」（如 `20% - 1cm`），要相对某个基准解析；`Fr` 是「剩余空间的分数」（fractional），永远最后参与分配。
17	- **`Region` / `Regions`**（u4-l4）：给子内容的「可用空间提案」。网格在测量 auto 列时，会给每个单元格发一个试探性的 pod region，让它先排一遍以获知自然宽度——这是本讲反复出现的模式。
18	- **`Frame` / `Fragment`**：`Frame` 是绝对定位的二维绘图树，且带**基线（baseline）**概念；`Fragment` 是一组 `Frame`（内容可能跨页）。
19	- **Synthesize 阶段**（u4-l2）：realize 之前，元素有机会把脚本参数「整理」成内部字段。`GridElem`/`TableElem` 正是在这里把用户输入编译成 `CellGrid`。
20	- **内置规则注册**（u4-l2）：`GRID_RULE`、`TABLE_RULE` 等常量经 `NativeRuleMap` 装配进 `Library`，把元素接线到具体布局函数。
21	- **试探布局（measure）**：先用一个假想的 region 布局一次、只取尺寸丢弃正式产物的做法。行内断行（u4-l5）里已经见过，网格测量 auto 列、列表测量 marker 都靠它。
22

26	| --- | --- |
27	| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs` | `Sizing` 枚举：轨道尺寸的三种形态（类型在 library，行为在 layout——u1-l3 的架构决策又一例） |

33	| `crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs` | 列表/枚举布局：`ListLayouter` 测量与 `ItemLayouter` 基线对齐（本讲讲它的「前世今生」） |
34	| `crates/typst-library/src/math/ir/` | 数学中间表示：`resolve_equation` 产出 `MathItem` / `MathKind` 树 |

37	| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/fraction.rs` | 分数布局：MATH 表常量驱动的拼装 |
38	| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/radical.rs` | 根式布局：拉伸根号、指数抬升 |
39	| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/table.rs` | 矩阵/向量布局：数学世界里的「小网格」 |
40	| `crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs` | 内置规则：`GRID_RULE` / `TABLE_RULE` / `LIST_RULE` / 文献表对网格的真复用 |
41	
42	数据流总览：
43	
44	```
45	脚本: #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), ...) / #table(...)
46	  │  GridElem::synthesize / TableElem::synthesize      (typst-library)
47	  ▼
48	CellGrid ── 轨道(含 gutter 交织) + Entry(Cell/Merged) + hlines/vlines + headers/footer
49	  │  GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE → BlockElem::multi_layouter (rules.rs)
50	  ▼
51	GridLayouter (typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs)
52	  │  measure_columns: 固定 → auto 试探测量 → fr 分红 / auto 公平收缩
53	  │  layout(): 逐行 layout_auto_row / layout_relative_row / Row::Fr
54	  ▼
55	Fragment (多页时含重复表头/跨页 rowspan)
56	
57	脚本: $ a/b + sqrt(x) $   (EquationElem)
58	  │  resolve_equation (typst-library/src/math/ir)
59	  ▼
60	MathItem 树 (MathKind::Fraction / Radical / Glyph / Table / ...)
61	  │  MathContext::layout_into_self 递归 + layout_realized 按 kind 派发
62	  ▼
63	MathFragment 流 → MathRun 行装配(row_into_line_frame / stack_rows) → Frame
64	```
65	
66	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
67	
68	### 4.1 模块一：网格轨道模型——从 `TrackSizings` 到 `CellGrid`
69	
70	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
71	
72	**轨道（track）** 是网格里一整列（或一整行）的尺寸单位，概念借自 CSS Grid。用户在脚本里写的 `columns: (60pt, 1fr, 2fr)` 就是一个轨道列表，每个轨道是三种尺寸之一：
73	
74	- `auto`：按内容自适应——把这一列所有单元格各排一遍，取最宽的；
75	- 固定或相对长度（`10pt`、`20% - 1cm`）：确切大小；
76	- `1fr`：所有其他轨道定下来之后，按分数瓜分剩余空间。
77	
78	`grid` 与 `table` 在 Typst 里是**两个语义不同的元素**（无障碍、样式互不影响），但在布局引擎层面**完全是同一台机器**：二者在 Synthesize 阶段都被编译成同一个内部结构 `CellGrid`，再交给同一个 `GridLayouter`。这是「一个通用引擎 + 多个语义外壳」的典型架构。
79	
80	`CellGrid` 解决的核心问题有三个：
81	
82	1. **轨道统一**：把用户给的列/行轨道与 gutter（列间距/行间距）轨道交织成一条统一的轨道序列，之后布局器不必再区分「内容轨道」和「间距轨道」；
83	2. **定位与合并**：单元格支持 `x`/`y` 手工定位和 `colspan`/`rowspan` 跨行列，被跨过的位置要标记为「已合并」，指向真正的父单元格；
84	3. **附属物收集**：`hline`/`vline` 线条、可跨页重复的表头（header）与表脚（footer）也被收进同一结构。
85	
86	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
87	
88	从脚本到布局的完整链路：
89	
90	```
91	GridElem / TableElem（脚本参数：columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke + children）
92	   │  Synthesize::synthesize
93	   │     grid_to_cellgrid(...) / table_to_cellgrid(...)
94	   ▼
95	CellGrid {
96	     cols/rows: Vec<Sizing>   ← 内容轨道与 gutter 轨道交织后的统一序列
97	     entries: Vec<Entry>      ← Entry::Cell(Cell) | Entry::Merged { parent }
98	     vlines / hlines          ← 显式线条
99	     headers / footer         ← 可重复表头表脚
100	 }
101	   │  realize 阶段: GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE
102	   │     → BlockElem::multi_layouter(elem, crate::grid::layout_grid / layout_table)
103	   ▼
104	GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, ...).layout(engine)   （模块二的主角）
105	```
106	
107	gutter 交织的规则（以 2 列 + gutter 为例）：`[列0, gutter, 列1, gutter, 列2, ...]`，最后一条多余的 gutter 会被 `pop` 掉。于是**偶数下标是内容轨道，奇数下标是 gutter 轨道**。
108	
109	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
110	
111	先看轨道尺寸的类型定义。`Sizing` 是一个三变体枚举，住在 typst-library：
112	
113	[`Sizing` 枚举定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs#L476-L485)——`Auto`、`Rel(Rel)`、`Fr(Fr)` 三种轨道形态，并提供 `is_auto()` / `is_fractional()` 谓词。用户脚本能写的所有轨道尺寸最终都归约到这三个变体。
114	
115	脚本参数到轨道列表的转换由 `TrackSizings` 完成：
116	
117	[`TrackSizings` 与其 cast 规则](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L453-L463)——这段代码实现了文档里的便捷写法：单个 `Sizing` 变单轨道；非零整数 `3` 展开成 `(auto, auto, auto)`（`smallvec![Sizing::Auto; count.get()]`）；数组逐项 cast。所以 `columns: 5` 与 `columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto)` 等价。
118	
119	`GridElem` 把这些参数声明为字段：
120	
121	[`GridElem` 的 columns/rows/gutter 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L183-L221)——注意 `gutter` 是 `#[external]` 的语法糖：真正的字段是 `column_gutter` 与 `row_gutter`，二者的 `#[parse]` 属性先找各自的命名参数、找不到就回落到 `gutter`。单元格的跨行列能力则在 `GridCell` 上：
122	
123	[`GridCell` 的 x/y/colspan/rowspan 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L804-L840)——`x`/`y` 支持手工定位（`Smart<usize>`，`auto` 表示顺流自动放置），`colspan`/`rowspan` 默认为 1，这就是「跨两列单元格」在数据层的样子。
124	
125	关键的一步发生在 Synthesize：
126	
127	[`GridElem` 的 Synthesize 实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L441-L451)——`grid_to_cellgrid(self, engine, styles)?` 把元素编译成 `CellGrid`，存进内部合成字段 `grid: Arc<CellGrid>`（[L411-L413](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L411-L420)）。布局阶段只需 `elem.grid.as_ref().unwrap()` 就能拿到现成结构，Synthesize 与 Layout 的分界正在这里。
128	
129	[`grid_to_cellgrid` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L27-L74)——把 columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke 逐个取出，children（Header/Footer/Item）映射成 `ResolvableGridChild`，最终交给通用的 `resolve_cellgrid`。`table` 那边几乎是逐行对称的代码：
130	
131	[`TableElem` 的 Synthesize](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/model/table.rs#L310-L320) 调用 [`table_to_cellgrid`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L78-L125)——两个函数体只有类型名不同。这就是「table 与 grid 共用引擎」在源码层的直接证据。
132	
133	解析产物 `CellGrid` 的结构：
134	
135	[`CellGrid` 结构定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L654-L677)——`entries` 是行优先的一维数组，`cols`/`rows` 是**含 gutter 轨道**的统一轨道序列，`vlines`/`hlines` 收显式线条，`headers`/`footer` 支撑跨页重复。每个位置上是：
136	
137	[`Entry` 枚举：Cell 或 Merged](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L625-L645)——被 colspan/rowspan 覆盖的位置不是空，而是 `Entry::Merged { parent }`，指向父单元格的下标；`parent_cell_position`（[L793-L803](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L786-L803)）负责把合并位置映射回父位置。布局器测量列宽时靠它避免重复测量同一个跨行列单元格。
138	
139	gutter 交织发生在构造函数里：
140	
141	[`CellGrid::new_internal` 的轨道交织](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L700-L742)——每个内容轨道后面 push 一条 gutter 轨道（`get_or` 让 gutter 列表循环复用、不足时补零），最后 `pop` 掉多余的最后一条。行数取「用户给的行数」与「按单元格数量推算的行数」的较大值（L708-L713），所以 `columns: 4` 时给 12 个单元格会自动长出 3 行。
142	
143	因为交织，访问 `(x, y)` 位置的坐标换算带了奇偶判断：
144	
145	[`CellGrid::entry` 的奇偶寻址](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L756-L776)——有 gutter 时偶数下标是内容、奇数下标是 gutter（返回 `None`），一维下标换算 `(y / 2) * c + x / 2`。
146	
147	最后看布局侧的接线。realize 阶段的内置规则把两个元素接到同一个模块：
148	
149	[`GRID_RULE` 与 `TABLE_RULE`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L538-L540)——`TABLE_RULE` 把 `TableElem` 包成携带 `crate::grid::layout_table` 回调的 `BlockElem::multi_layouter`（`GRID_RULE` 在 [L698-L700](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L698-L700) 对称地接 `layout_grid`）。这正是 u4-l2 讲过的 `NativeRuleMap` 机制：元素不变，行为经函数指针注入。
150	
151	[`layout_grid` 与 `layout_table` 入口](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L98-L122)——两个函数都是三行：取出 Synthesize 阶段存好的 `CellGrid`，`GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, locator, styles, span).layout(engine)`。区别只在元素类型，引擎零差异。
152	
153	顺带一提，同文件里的 [`layout_cell`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L30-L85) 是网格递归布局的最内层：任何单元格最终都回到 `crate::layout_fragment` 通用入口，还会为 table/grid 单元格手工生成 introspection 标签（与 u4-l7 的内省机制相接）。
154	
155	#### 4.1.4 代码实践
156	
157	**实践目标**：亲眼确认「colspan 在数据层是 `Entry::Merged`」，并跑通一个现成的跨列测试。
158	
159	1. 阅读现成测试 [`tests/suite/layout/grid/colspan.typ` 的 grid-colspan 用例](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/colspan.typ#L1-L30)：它同时放了 `grid` 与 `table` 两个版本，第一行 `grid.cell(colspan: 4)[*Full Header*]` 跨满 4 列，第二行两个 `colspan: 2` 各跨一半。

161

163	   cargo testit grid-colspan
164	   ```

167	4. 把同一份 .typ 内容存成 `grid-practice.typ`，用 `cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile grid-practice.typ` 编译，肉眼核对跨列单元格的填充色块确实横跨对应列。
168	
169	**需要观察的现象**：`grid` 与 `table` 两个版本的输出像素级一致（仅 fill 略有差异的行除外）——因为它们走的是同一台 `GridLayouter`。

172	
173	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
174	
175	**练习 1**：`columns: 3` 和 `columns: (auto,)` 分别展开成什么？
176	
177	> **答案**：`columns: 3` 经 `TrackSizings` 的 `NonZeroUsize` 分支展开为 `(auto, auto, auto)`；`columns: (auto,)` 就是单条 auto 轨道。注意文档特别说明：对 columns 而言单个值只会产生**一列**，这与 rows/gutter「单值循环复用」的行为不同（`get_or` 的循环复用只发生在 gutter 与超出给定长度的 rows 上）。
178	
179	**练习 2**：为什么 `GridElem` 要在 Synthesize 阶段就把脚本参数编译成 `CellGrid`，而不是留到布局函数里现算？
180

189	### 4.2 模块二：轨道尺寸协商——`measure_columns` 的三方谈判
190	
191	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
192	
193	网格最核心的问题是：**每条轨道到底多宽？** Typst 的答案是一场固定次序的「三方谈判」：
194	
195	1. **固定轨道**（`Rel`）先行：相对基准宽度解析成绝对值，占用从不动摇；
196	2. **`auto` 轨道**其次：把这一列的每个单元格用试探 region 排一遍，取最大自然宽度——这就是 CSS 里的 max-content 测量；
197	3. **`fr` 轨道**最后：若还有剩余空间，按分数比例瓜分（`1fr` 与 `3fr` 按 1:3 分）；若 `auto` 们已经把空间吃超了，则反过来让超标的 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」到同一宽度。
198	
199	行方向（`rows`）用同一套 `Sizing` 语义，但多了两个变数：`auto` 行可能**跨区域断开**（长单元格跨页续排），`fr` 行只是先登记、等区域收尾时才知道自己分到多高。
200	
201	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
202	
203	列方向协商的伪代码（对应 `measure_columns`）：
204	
205	```
206	rel = Σ 固定轨道解析值        # 先解析所有 Rel 列
207	fr  = Σ fr 轨道的份数
208	available = region宽度 − rel
209	
210	if available ≥ 0:
211	    (auto, count) = measure_auto_columns(available)   # 试探布局取最大
212	    remaining = available − auto
213	    if remaining ≥ 0:
214	        grow_fractional_columns(remaining, fr)        # fr 按比例分红
215	    else:
216	        shrink_auto_columns(available, count)         # auto 公平收缩
217	```
218	
219	fr 分红公式（`Fr::share`）：
220	
221	\[ w_i = \frac{f_i}{\sum_j f_j} \cdot \max(\text{remaining},\ 0) \]
222	
223	auto 公平收缩（`shrink_auto_columns`）是一个迭代剔除过程：反复计算 `fair = redistribute / overlarge`，把「不超标」（`rcol ≤ fair`）的 auto 列移出待分集合、把它们占用的宽度还给公共池，直到集合不再变化；最后所有仍超标的列统一压到 `fair`。这保证**收缩负担只落在确实过宽的列上**，窄列不受牵连。
224	
225	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
226	
227	主入口：
228	
229	[`measure_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L914-L957)——先扫一遍所有列：`Sizing::Rel(v)` 解析进 `rel`（`v.resolve(styles).relative_to(self.regions.base().x)`），`Sizing::Fr(v)` 累进 `fr`；然后 `available = regions.size.x − rel`，按剩余空间走向 `measure_auto_columns` → `grow_fractional_columns` 或 `shrink_auto_columns`。整个函数 40 行出头，是「谈判议程表」本身。
230	
231	auto 测量是网格里最精巧的部分：
232	
233	[`measure_auto_columns` 主体](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L985-L1099)——对每个 auto 列，遍历该列所有行：经 `parent_cell_position` 找到父单元格（跳过合并位置与已测过的 rowspan，L991-L999）；构造试探 pod `Region::new(Size::new(available, height), Axes::splat(false))` 调 `layout_cell` 真排一遍，`resolved.set_max(frame.width() - already_covered_width)` 取最大值。`already_covered_width`（[L1076](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1076)）减去跨列单元格已从**先前解析的列**那里获得的宽度——一个跨 3 列的宽单元格不应把 3 列都撑到自己的全宽。
234	
235	跨列单元格还有两条专门规则：
236	
237	[colspan 只影响最后一条 auto 列 + 全 fr 列启发式](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1001-L1036)——(1) 跨列单元格只把自己「多出来的宽度」记到它所跨的**最后一条** auto 列头上（其余位置 `continue`）；(2) 若单元格已经跨过了网格里**全部** fr 列且区域宽度有限，则干脆不撑宽 auto 列——fr 列分红后自然会腾出空间给它。这两条规则对应的测试就在 [`colspan.typ` 的 grid-colspan-over-all-fr-columns 等用例](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/colspan.typ#L92-L116)。
238	
239	fr 分红：
240	
241	[`grow_fractional_columns` 与 `Fr::share`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1101-L1112)——每条 fr 列分得 `v.share(fr, remaining)`，[`share` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/fr.rs#L56-L63) 就是上面的比例公式，`remaining.max(Abs::zero())` 保证负余量不分倒扣。
242	
243	公平收缩：
244	
245	[`shrink_auto_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1114-L1145)——`while changed && overlarge > 0` 循环不断剔除不需要收缩的列并重算 `fair`，末尾把所有 `rcol > fair` 的 auto 列钳到 `fair`。注释原文「Redistribute space to auto columns so that each gets a fair share」正是文档里「auto 轨道公平分配可用空间」承诺的落点。
246	
247	行方向的派发在主循环里：
248	
249	[`layout_row_internal` 按行轨道类型派发](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L425-L464)——`Sizing::Auto` 走 `layout_auto_row`（先测量后正式布局，可跨区域断开续排）、`Sizing::Rel` 走 `layout_relative_row`、`Sizing::Fr` 只是把 `Row::Fr(v, y, disambiguator)` 压进当前区域（[L452-L457](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L446-L458)），等 `finish_region` 收尾时才知道实际高度——与 u4-l4 里 flow 对 `fr` 间距的处理如出一辙。`Row` 枚举（[L214-L224](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L214-L224)）因此分 `Frame`（已完成的行）与 `Fr`（待分红的行）两态。
250	
251	整场谈判的调度者是 [`GridLayouter::layout` 主循环](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L313-L388)：先 `measure_columns` 定列宽，再处理重复表脚预留、逐行推进（跳过表头区间、遇到 footer 布局表脚）、收尾区域、补排遗漏的 rowspan，最后 `render_fills_strokes` 补线与背景。

284	**练习 1**：`columns: (60pt, 1fr)`、页宽 100pt、只有一个空单元格，1fr 列多宽？
285	
286	> **答案**：rel = 60pt，available = 40pt；auto 列不存在，auto 总量为 0；remaining = 40pt ≥ 0，唯一 fr 列分得全部 40pt。（`Fr::share` 中 \(1/1 \times 40 = 40\)。）

288	**练习 2**：三个 auto 列测量出 50pt、30pt、20pt，available 只有 60pt，最终各多宽？
289

293	
294	> **答案**：`fr` 的语义是「其他轨道分完之后的剩余空间」，而网格可能跨多个区域（页）：必须等当前区域里所有固定/自动行都排完、`finish_region` 时才知道剩余高度，才能给 `Row::Fr` 定高。这正是 `Row::Fr` 只登记不布局、推迟到收尾的原因（与 u4-l4 中 flow 对 fr 间距的延迟处理同构）。

298	### 4.3 模块三：列表复用——一段架构演进史
299	
300	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
301	
302	大纲给本模块起名「列表项复用网格的方式」。**这个说法描述的是历史版本，而当前 HEAD 已经不是这样了**——这本身就是极好的架构课：
303	
304	- **旧设计（≈ 2026 年 5 月之前）**：`lists.rs` 里 `layout_list`/`layout_enum` 亲手构造一个两列 `CellGrid`（marker 列 + body 列），交给 `GridLayouter` 布局。列表 = 一种特殊的网格，复用整套 auto 轨道测量与跨页协商。
305	- **现设计**：提交 `b241417c4`（*Improved list layout (#7895)*，2026-05-27）重写为专用的 `ListLayouter` + `ItemLayouter`，每一项经 `StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter` 回调交给**栈布局**（`layout_stack_internal`）。
306	
307	替换的直接动机是**基线对齐**：用户要求列表 marker（如 `1.`、`a)`）与正文第一行基线对齐（`number-align` / `marker-align`）。网格的行模型以「行框」为单位，表达不了「把 marker 下移 x pt，或把 body 重新排版并下移」这种非对称微调（见 4.3.3 的 `baseline_align`），于是列表走上了专用路径。
308	
309	「复用网格」今天依然存在，只是搬了家：**文献目录（bibliography）**在 realize 阶段真的构造一个 `GridElem` 来排两栏文献条目；**table** 更是整个复用网格引擎（本讲 4.1）。所以准确的结论是：*通用引擎负责真正二维的场合，二维性很弱（两列、基线驱动）的列表退回专用实现。*
310	
311	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
312	
313	当前 `layout_items` 的四步流程（源码 doc comment 原文总结）：
314	
315	```
316	1. measure_markers   —— 逐项试探布局 marker，取最大宽度（marker_width）
317	                        （这就是「auto 轨道测量」的迷你版！）
318	2. measure_bodies    —— 仅当区域宽度无限或 width: auto 时，测 body 最大宽度，
319	                        让各项在彼此之间对齐而不是对齐页宽
320	3. layout_item       —— 每项一个 ItemLayouter：排 marker、排 body、
321	                        基线对齐（或显式垂直对齐）
322	4. layout_stack_internal —— 各项作为 StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter
323	                        交给栈布局器纵向堆叠（间距 = spacing/tight 逻辑）
324	```

408	### 4.4 模块四：数学排版结构——`MathItem`、`MathRun` 与分数/根式
409	
410	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
411	
412	数学排版与普通流式排版是两个世界：公式不是「块从上往下、字从左往右」的流，而是**嵌套盒子的递归组合**——分数把两个子公式上下摞、根式把 radicand 包进拉伸过的根号、矩阵把一堆公式排成阵列。Typst 把这套逻辑分成两层：
413	
414	- **typst-library 的 `math::ir`**：`resolve_equation` 把求值后的公式内容解析成中间表示 `MathItem` 树（`MathKind::Fraction` / `Radical` / `Glyph` / `Table` 等 19 种，外加 `MathProperties` 携带数学类别、字号档位、左右间距等属性）；
415	- **typst-layout 的 `math` 模块**：`MathContext` 递归消费这棵树，每个节点产出一串 `MathFragment`（字形/子帧/空隙），同层的片段组成 `MathRun`（一行），按**基线**对齐拼进 `Frame`。
416	
417	两个贯穿全模块的几何概念：
418	
419	- **基线（baseline）**：帧内 y 坐标的一个刻度。同一行的所有片段按各自 ascent/descent 对齐到公共基线；分数、根式产出的复合帧也自带基线，于是能无限嵌套。
420	- **轴线（axis height）**：数学意义上的「公式竖直中心」，比基线略高（约半个 x 字高）。分数的横线、矩阵的整体基线都以轴为参照，来自字体 MATH 表的 `axis_height` 常量。
421	
422	所有尺寸细节（分数线上移量、根号间隙、上下标缩放比例）都不是硬编码，而是**逐项查当前数学字体 OpenType MATH 表的常量**——这正是 Typst 换数学字体后排版感会变的原理。
423	
424	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
425	
426	一个行内公式 $a/b + sqrt(x)$ 的完整旅程：
427	
428	```
429	$ ... $ 源码
430	  │  typst-eval 求值出 EquationElem 的 body（内容树）
431	  │  行内: inline.rs 收集阶段把它作为 InlineItem 交给 math 模块（u4-l5 衔接点）
432	  ▼
433	resolve_equation (typst-library/src/math/ir/mod.rs)
434	  ▼
435	MathItem 树: Group[ Fraction(a,b) 的组件, Glyph(+), Radical(x) ... ]
436	  │  layout_equation_inline / layout_equation_block
437	  ▼
438	MathContext（携带字体栈与片段收集器）
439	  │  layout_into_self: 逐项 layout_realized，按 MathKind 派发：
440	  │    Fraction → layout_fraction（MATH 常量拼装，产出带基线的子帧）
441	  │    Radical  → layout_radical（拉伸根号 + 指数抬升）
442	  │    Table    → layout_table（矩阵：列内子列宽协商 + stack_rows）
443	  │    ...     → 其余 15 种
444	  ▼
445	MathRun = Vec<MathFragment>   （一行片段流）
446	  │  row_into_line_frame: y = row_ascent − frag.ascent()，全部落到公共基线
447	  │  行内公式再经 into_par_items: 在二元/关系运算符处切开 → 给段落断行机会
448	  ▼
449	Frame（带 baseline）→ 回到行内排版 / 块级 flow
450	```
451	
452	行装配的核心不变式：一行里第 i 个片段的放置纵坐标为
453	
454	\[ y_i = \text{row\_ascent} - \text{ascent}_i, \qquad \text{row\_ascent} = \max_i \text{ascent}_i \]
455	
456	于是所有片段的基线恰好落在 `y = row_ascent` 这条水平线上。

524	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
525	
526	**练习 1**：为什么 `MathFragment` 要统一提供 `ascent()`/`descent()`，而不是只给 `height()`？
527	
528	> **答案**：数学行装配的对齐基准是**基线**而非顶边。一个分数帧和一个普通字母 x 高度不同，但只要按 `y = row_ascent − frag.ascent()` 放置，它们的基线就共线；只知 height 无法完成这种对齐，嵌套结构（分数套根式套上下标）也会失去对齐依据。
529	
530	**练习 2**：矩阵（`math/table.rs`）的基线为什么是 `height/2 + axis` 而不是第一行的基线？
531	
532	> **答案**：矩阵作为整体出现在公式中时，数学惯例是让它的**竖直中心对准轴线**（分数横线所在的水平线），这样 $[\begin{smallmatrix}a\\b\end{smallmatrix}] + c$ 里加号与矩阵整体视觉居中。若用首行基线，行数越多矩阵越向下溢出轴线。
533	
534	**练习 3**：行内公式为什么要在二元/关系运算符处把片段流切开（`into_par_items`）？
535	
536	> **答案**：这是数学给段落断行器（u4-l5）留的「合法断点」：长公式在 `+`、`=` 处允许换行，其他位置（如标识符内部）不允许。切分成多个 `InlineItem::Frame` 后，断行器把它们当作不可再分的行内物件，只能在这些边界处考虑断行；同时在运算符后插入零宽断行机会，运算符留在行尾。
537	
538	---
539	
540	## 5. 综合实践
541	
542	把本讲三个模块串成一个任务：**给一张「跨两列 + auto 轨道」的表格做一次完整的列宽审计，再对比一条分数公式的布局参数。**
543	
544	**任务设定**：新建 `audit.typ`：
545	
546	```typst
547	#set page(width: 200pt)
548	#table(
549	  columns: (auto, auto, 1fr),
550	  table.cell(colspan: 2)[跨两列的表头],
551	  [c],
552	  [短], [稍微长一点的单元格], [占满剩余空间的列],
553	  [x], [y], [z],
554	)
555	$ (dif y)/(dif x) = root(3, x + 1) $
556	```
557	
558	**步骤**：
559	
560	1. **手算（模块二）**：固定轨道 0 条；两条 auto 列。先按 `measure_auto_columns` 的规则推演：跨两列的表头只把它「超出第一列已解析宽度」的部分记到**第二条** auto 列（4.2.3 的规则一）；auto 总量确定后，`1fr` 分走 `200pt − gutter − inset − auto 总量`。写下每列的预测宽度。
561	2. **对照源码解释**：在 `measure_columns` → `measure_auto_columns` → `grow_fractional_columns` 三处各设一个临时 `eprintln!` 打点（打印 `available` / 每条 auto 列的 `resolved` / `remaining`），重编译后跑 `cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile audit.typ audit.pdf`，把打点数值与手算对照，用一段话解释「列宽如何确定」。
562	3. **验证表格语义（模块一）**：确认输出里表头单元格横跨两列、线条绘制正确；再把 `table.cell(colspan: 2)` 改成 `grid.cell(colspan: 2)`（放进 `#grid(...)`），观察编译报错——阅读 [`GridItem::try_from` 的排错分支](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L529-L573) 里 "cannot use `table.cell` as a grid cell" 的提示，理解两个语义外壳在解析层的隔离。
563	4. **观察公式（模块四）**：按 4.4.4 的打点方法记录这条公式的分数与根式参数，画出「分数线 y 坐标 = 基线 − axis、根号拉伸目标高度」的示意，标注在输出的 PNG 上。
564	5. **清理**：还原所有源码打点；`git status` 确认工作区只剩你新建的 .typ 与 .png/.pdf 产物（建议移出仓库或加入忽略）。
565	
566	**预期结果**：手算、打点、渲染三者互相印证；能用自己的话说出「固定 → auto → fr」的谈判顺序与 colspan 的记账规则。所有编译产物数值待本地验证。
567	
568	## 6. 本讲小结
569	
570	- **轨道模型**：`grid` 与 `table` 是同引擎的双外壳——Synthesize 阶段 `grid_to_cellgrid`/`table_to_cellgrid` 把脚本参数编译成统一的 `CellGrid`（轨道与 gutter 交织、`Entry::Cell/Merged` 合并记账、表头表脚内建），`GridLayouter` 只认 `CellGrid`。
571	- **尺寸协商**：`measure_columns` 的固定议程——`Rel` 轨道先解析，`auto` 轨道用试探布局取 max-content（跨列单元格只记账到最后一条 auto 列），剩余空间按 \( f_i/\sum f_j \) 分给 `fr`，不足时超标 auto 列迭代收缩到公平份额；行方向同语义，但 auto 行可跨区域、fr 行延迟到收尾。
572	- **列表的演进**：列表曾用两列 `CellGrid` 复用网格引擎，2026-05（`b241417c4`）起改为专用 `ListLayouter`（marker/body 预测量 + `StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter` 栈堆叠），动机是网格表达不了的非对称基线对齐；今天真正复用网格的是 bibliography 与 table。
573	- **数学排版**：library 侧 `resolve_equation` 产出 `MathItem`（19 种 `MathKind` + `MathProperties`），layout 侧 `MathContext` 递归派发，一切坍缩为带 ascent/descent 的 `MathFragment`，行装配按 `y = row_ascent − ascent_i` 共线基线；分数/根式/矩阵的每个间隙都查字体 MATH 表常量，矩阵基线对轴不对基线。
574	- **方法论**：看到「XX 是不是复用了 YY」这类说法，先 `git log`/`git show` 查证当前 HEAD——架构结论是有时效的，本讲的列表就是活例。
575	
576	## 7. 下一步学习建议
577	
578	- **下一讲 u4-l7（内省机制）**：本讲多处埋了钩子——`layout_cell` 手工生成的 Tag、跨页重复表头的 `disambiguator`、块级公式编号用的 `Counter::of(EquationElem::ELEM)`，都依赖 introspection。下一讲讲清 `Location`/`query`/两遍编译如何让这些「跨页重复的东西」拥有稳定身份。
579	- **继续深挖网格**：`grid/rowspans.rs`（跨行单元格跨页拆分）、`grid/repeated.rs`（表头表脚重复）、`grid/lines.rs`（hline/vline 与单元格描边的优先级合并）是三个独立专题，各自对应 `tests/suite/layout/grid/` 下的同名主题测试。
580	- **数学进阶**：`math/scripts.rs`（上下标与 limits）、`math/shaping.rs` 与 `fragment/glyph.rs`（数学字形与拉伸）、`typst-library/src/math/ir/resolve.rs`（IR 是怎么从内容树建出来的）值得各花半小时。
581	- **对照阅读**：CSS Grid 的轨道尺寸算法（MDN "Grid sizing"）与本讲 `measure_columns` 异曲同工，比较两者的 auto 分布策略能加深理解。

# 网格世界：grid、table、列表与数学布局

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 **轨道（track）** 的数据模型：`Sizing` 的三种形态（`auto` / 固定或相对长度 / `fr`）如何在 `CellGrid` 中统一成带 gutter 的轨道序列，`table` 为什么和 `grid` 共用同一台布局引擎。
2. 讲清 **轨道尺寸协商** 的完整顺序：固定轨道先解析 → `auto` 轨道用试探布局测量 → 剩余空间按比例分给 `fr` 轨道（或空间不足时让 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」），并能手工推算一张表格的列宽。
3. 描述 `lists.rs` 列表布局的 **架构演进**：它曾经真的复用网格引擎（`CellGrid` + `GridLayouter`），2026 年 5 月起改为专用的 `ListLayouter` + 栈布局，理解这次替换背后的动机（基线对齐）。
4. 了解数学排版如何组织 **符号行与嵌套结构**：`MathItem` 中间表示 → `MathFragment` 片段流 → `MathRun` 行装配，以及分数与根式如何用字体 MATH 表常量逐块拼装并对齐基线。

本讲是第四单元「排版管线」的倒数第二讲：u4-l4 讲了 flow 如何把块级内容分配进 region，u4-l5 讲了行内断行；本讲看两个「二维」的特化布局器——网格与数学公式，它们都建立在前面的 region 协商机制之上。

## 2. 前置知识

- **`Abs` / `Rel` / `Fr`**：`Abs` 是绝对长度（pt）；`Rel` 是「比例 × 基准 + 绝对部分」（如 `20% - 1cm`），要相对某个基准解析；`Fr` 是「剩余空间的分数」（fractional），永远最后参与分配。
- **`Region` / `Regions`**（u4-l4）：给子内容的「可用空间提案」。网格在测量 auto 列时，会给每个单元格发一个试探性的 pod region，让它先排一遍以获知自然宽度——这是本讲反复出现的模式。
- **`Frame` / `Fragment`**：`Frame` 是绝对定位的二维绘图树，且带**基线（baseline）**概念；`Fragment` 是一组 `Frame`（内容可能跨页）。
- **Synthesize 阶段**（u4-l2）：realize 之前，元素有机会把脚本参数「整理」成内部字段。`GridElem`/`TableElem` 正是在这里把用户输入编译成 `CellGrid`。
- **内置规则注册**（u4-l2）：`GRID_RULE`、`TABLE_RULE` 等常量经 `NativeRuleMap` 装配进 `Library`，把元素接线到具体布局函数。
- **试探布局（measure）**：先用一个假想的 region 布局一次、只取尺寸丢弃正式产物的做法。行内断行（u4-l5）里已经见过，网格测量 auto 列、列表测量 marker 都靠它。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs` | `Sizing` 枚举：轨道尺寸的三种形态（类型在 library，行为在 layout——u1-l3 的架构决策又一例） |
| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs` | `GridElem` / `GridCell` / `TrackSizings` 的定义与 Synthesize 入口 |
| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs` | `grid_to_cellgrid` / `table_to_cellgrid`：把脚本输入解析为 `CellGrid`（单元格定位、跨行列合并、gutter 交织、表头表脚） |
| `crates/typst-library/src/model/table.rs` | `TableElem` 的 Synthesize：`table` 与 `grid` 在这一层汇合 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs` | 布局侧入口：`layout_grid` / `layout_table` / `layout_cell` |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs` | `GridLayouter`：轨道尺寸协商（`measure_columns` 一族）与逐行布局主循环 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs` | 列表/枚举布局：`ListLayouter` 测量与 `ItemLayouter` 基线对齐（本讲讲它的「前世今生」） |
| `crates/typst-library/src/math/ir/` | 数学中间表示：`resolve_equation` 产出 `MathItem` / `MathKind` 树 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/mod.rs` | 数学布局入口 `layout_equation_inline` / `layout_equation_block` 与 `MathContext` |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/run.rs` | `MathRun` / `stack_rows`：符号行装配、对齐点、行内断行机会 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/fraction.rs` | 分数布局：MATH 表常量驱动的拼装 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/radical.rs` | 根式布局：拉伸根号、指数抬升 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/table.rs` | 矩阵/向量布局：数学世界里的「小网格」 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs` | 内置规则：`GRID_RULE` / `TABLE_RULE` / `LIST_RULE` / 文献表对网格的真复用 |

数据流总览：

```
脚本: #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), ...) / #table(...)
  │  GridElem::synthesize / TableElem::synthesize      (typst-library)
  ▼
CellGrid ── 轨道(含 gutter 交织) + Entry(Cell/Merged) + hlines/vlines + headers/footer
  │  GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE → BlockElem::multi_layouter (rules.rs)
  ▼
GridLayouter (typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs)
  │  measure_columns: 固定 → auto 试探测量 → fr 分红 / auto 公平收缩
  │  layout(): 逐行 layout_auto_row / layout_relative_row / Row::Fr
  ▼
Fragment (多页时含重复表头/跨页 rowspan)

脚本: $ a/b + sqrt(x) $   (EquationElem)
  │  resolve_equation (typst-library/src/math/ir)
  ▼
MathItem 树 (MathKind::Fraction / Radical / Glyph / Table / ...)
  │  MathContext::layout_into_self 递归 + layout_realized 按 kind 派发
  ▼
MathFragment 流 → MathRun 行装配(row_into_line_frame / stack_rows) → Frame
```

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块一：网格轨道模型——从 `TrackSizings` 到 `CellGrid`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

**轨道（track）** 是网格里一整列（或一整行）的尺寸单位，概念借自 CSS Grid。用户在脚本里写的 `columns: (60pt, 1fr, 2fr)` 就是一个轨道列表，每个轨道是三种尺寸之一：

- `auto`：按内容自适应——把这一列所有单元格各排一遍，取最宽的；
- 固定或相对长度（`10pt`、`20% - 1cm`）：确切大小；
- `1fr`：所有其他轨道定下来之后，按分数瓜分剩余空间。

`grid` 与 `table` 在 Typst 里是**两个语义不同的元素**（无障碍、样式互不影响），但在布局引擎层面**完全是同一台机器**：二者在 Synthesize 阶段都被编译成同一个内部结构 `CellGrid`，再交给同一个 `GridLayouter`。这是「一个通用引擎 + 多个语义外壳」的典型架构。

`CellGrid` 解决的核心问题有三个：

1. **轨道统一**：把用户给的列/行轨道与 gutter（列间距/行间距）轨道交织成一条统一的轨道序列，之后布局器不必再区分「内容轨道」和「间距轨道」；
2. **定位与合并**：单元格支持 `x`/`y` 手工定位和 `colspan`/`rowspan` 跨行列，被跨过的位置要标记为「已合并」，指向真正的父单元格；
3. **附属物收集**：`hline`/`vline` 线条、可跨页重复的表头（header）与表脚（footer）也被收进同一结构。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

从脚本到布局的完整链路：

```
GridElem / TableElem（脚本参数：columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke + children）
   │  Synthesize::synthesize
   │     grid_to_cellgrid(...) / table_to_cellgrid(...)
   ▼
CellGrid {
     cols/rows: Vec<Sizing>   ← 内容轨道与 gutter 轨道交织后的统一序列
     entries: Vec<Entry>      ← Entry::Cell(Cell) | Entry::Merged { parent }
     vlines / hlines          ← 显式线条
     headers / footer         ← 可重复表头表脚
 }
   │  realize 阶段: GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE
   │     → BlockElem::multi_layouter(elem, crate::grid::layout_grid / layout_table)
   ▼
GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, ...).layout(engine)   （模块二的主角）
```

gutter 交织的规则（以 2 列 + gutter 为例）：`[列0, gutter, 列1, gutter, 列2, ...]`，最后一条多余的 gutter 会被 `pop` 掉。于是**偶数下标是内容轨道，奇数下标是 gutter 轨道**。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看轨道尺寸的类型定义。`Sizing` 是一个三变体枚举，住在 typst-library：

[`Sizing` 枚举定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs#L476-L485)——`Auto`、`Rel(Rel)`、`Fr(Fr)` 三种轨道形态，并提供 `is_auto()` / `is_fractional()` 谓词。用户脚本能写的所有轨道尺寸最终都归约到这三个变体。

脚本参数到轨道列表的转换由 `TrackSizings` 完成：

[`TrackSizings` 与其 cast 规则](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L453-L463)——这段代码实现了文档里的便捷写法：单个 `Sizing` 变单轨道；非零整数 `3` 展开成 `(auto, auto, auto)`（`smallvec![Sizing::Auto; count.get()]`）；数组逐项 cast。所以 `columns: 5` 与 `columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto)` 等价。

`GridElem` 把这些参数声明为字段：

[`GridElem` 的 columns/rows/gutter 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L183-L221)——注意 `gutter` 是 `#[external]` 的语法糖：真正的字段是 `column_gutter` 与 `row_gutter`，二者的 `#[parse]` 属性先找各自的命名参数、找不到就回落到 `gutter`。单元格的跨行列能力则在 `GridCell` 上：

[`GridCell` 的 x/y/colspan/rowspan 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L804-L840)——`x`/`y` 支持手工定位（`Smart<usize>`，`auto` 表示顺流自动放置），`colspan`/`rowspan` 默认为 1，这就是「跨两列单元格」在数据层的样子。

关键的一步发生在 Synthesize：

[`GridElem` 的 Synthesize 实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L441-L451)——`grid_to_cellgrid(self, engine, styles)?` 把元素编译成 `CellGrid`，存进内部合成字段 `grid: Arc<CellGrid>`（[L411-L413](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L411-L420)）。布局阶段只需 `elem.grid.as_ref().unwrap()` 就能拿到现成结构，Synthesize 与 Layout 的分界正在这里。

[`grid_to_cellgrid` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L27-L74)——把 columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke 逐个取出，children（Header/Footer/Item）映射成 `ResolvableGridChild`，最终交给通用的 `resolve_cellgrid`。`table` 那边几乎是逐行对称的代码：

[`TableElem` 的 Synthesize](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/model/table.rs#L310-L320) 调用 [`table_to_cellgrid`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L78-L125)——两个函数体只有类型名不同。这就是「table 与 grid 共用引擎」在源码层的直接证据。

解析产物 `CellGrid` 的结构：

[`CellGrid` 结构定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L654-L677)——`entries` 是行优先的一维数组，`cols`/`rows` 是**含 gutter 轨道**的统一轨道序列，`vlines`/`hlines` 收显式线条，`headers`/`footer` 支撑跨页重复。每个位置上是：

[`Entry` 枚举：Cell 或 Merged](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L625-L645)——被 colspan/rowspan 覆盖的位置不是空，而是 `Entry::Merged { parent }`，指向父单元格的下标；`parent_cell_position`（[L793-L803](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L786-L803)）负责把合并位置映射回父位置。布局器测量列宽时靠它避免重复测量同一个跨行列单元格。

gutter 交织发生在构造函数里：

[`CellGrid::new_internal` 的轨道交织](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L700-L742)——每个内容轨道后面 push 一条 gutter 轨道（`get_or` 让 gutter 列表循环复用、不足时补零），最后 `pop` 掉多余的最后一条。行数取「用户给的行数」与「按单元格数量推算的行数」的较大值（L708-L713），所以 `columns: 4` 时给 12 个单元格会自动长出 3 行。

因为交织，访问 `(x, y)` 位置的坐标换算带了奇偶判断：

[`CellGrid::entry` 的奇偶寻址](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L756-L776)——有 gutter 时偶数下标是内容、奇数下标是 gutter（返回 `None`），一维下标换算 `(y / 2) * c + x / 2`。

最后看布局侧的接线。realize 阶段的内置规则把两个元素接到同一个模块：

[`GRID_RULE` 与 `TABLE_RULE`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L538-L540)——`TABLE_RULE` 把 `TableElem` 包成携带 `crate::grid::layout_table` 回调的 `BlockElem::multi_layouter`（`GRID_RULE` 在 [L698-L700](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L698-L700) 对称地接 `layout_grid`）。这正是 u4-l2 讲过的 `NativeRuleMap` 机制：元素不变，行为经函数指针注入。

[`layout_grid` 与 `layout_table` 入口](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L98-L122)——两个函数都是三行：取出 Synthesize 阶段存好的 `CellGrid`，`GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, locator, styles, span).layout(engine)`。区别只在元素类型，引擎零差异。

顺带一提，同文件里的 [`layout_cell`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L30-L85) 是网格递归布局的最内层：任何单元格最终都回到 `crate::layout_fragment` 通用入口，还会为 table/grid 单元格手工生成 introspection 标签（与 u4-l7 的内省机制相接）。

### 4.2 模块二：轨道尺寸协商——`measure_columns` 的三方谈判

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

网格最核心的问题是：**每条轨道到底多宽？** Typst 的答案是一场固定次序的「三方谈判」：

1. **固定轨道**（`Rel`）先行：相对基准宽度解析成绝对值，占用从不动摇；
2. **`auto` 轨道**其次：把这一列的每个单元格用试探 region 排一遍，取最大自然宽度——这就是 CSS 里的 max-content 测量；
3. **`fr` 轨道**最后：若还有剩余空间，按分数比例瓜分（`1fr` 与 `3fr` 按 1:3 分）；若 `auto` 们已经把空间吃超了，则反过来让超标的 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」到同一宽度。

行方向（`rows`）用同一套 `Sizing` 语义，但多了两个变数：`auto` 行可能**跨区域断开**（长单元格跨页续排），`fr` 行只是先登记、等区域收尾时才知道自己分到多高。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

列方向协商的伪代码（对应 `measure_columns`）：

```
rel = Σ 固定轨道解析值        # 先解析所有 Rel 列
fr  = Σ fr 轨道的份数
available = region宽度 − rel

if available ≥ 0:
    (auto, count) = measure_auto_columns(available)   # 试探布局取最大
    remaining = available − auto
    if remaining ≥ 0:
        grow_fractional_columns(remaining, fr)        # fr 按比例分红
    else:
        shrink_auto_columns(available, count)         # auto 公平收缩
```

fr 分红公式（`Fr::share`）：

\[ w_i = \frac{f_i}{\sum_j f_j} \cdot \max(\text{remaining},\ 0) \]

auto 公平收缩（`shrink_auto_columns`）是一个迭代剔除过程：反复计算 `fair = redistribute / overlarge`，把「不超标」（`rcol ≤ fair`）的 auto 列移出待分集合、把它们占用的宽度还给公共池，直到集合不再变化；最后所有仍超标的列统一压到 `fair`。这保证**收缩负担只落在确实过宽的列上**，窄列不受牵连。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

主入口：

[`measure_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L914-L957)——先扫一遍所有列：`Sizing::Rel(v)` 解析进 `rel`（`v.resolve(styles).relative_to(self.regions.base().x)`），`Sizing::Fr(v)` 累进 `fr`；然后 `available = regions.size.x − rel`，按剩余空间走向 `measure_auto_columns` → `grow_fractional_columns` 或 `shrink_auto_columns`。整个函数 40 行出头，是「谈判议程表」本身。

auto 测量是网格里最精巧的部分：

[`measure_auto_columns` 主体](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L985-L1099)——对每个 auto 列，遍历该列所有行：经 `parent_cell_position` 找到父单元格（跳过合并位置与已测过的 rowspan，L991-L999）；构造试探 pod `Region::new(Size::new(available, height), Axes::splat(false))` 调 `layout_cell` 真排一遍，`resolved.set_max(frame.width() - already_covered_width)` 取最大值。`already_covered_width`（[L1076](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1076)）减去跨列单元格已从**先前解析的列**那里获得的宽度——一个跨 3 列的宽单元格不应把 3 列都撑到自己的全宽。

跨列单元格还有两条专门规则：

[colspan 只影响最后一条 auto 列 + 全 fr 列启发式](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1001-L1036)——(1) 跨列单元格只把自己「多出来的宽度」记到它所跨的**最后一条** auto 列头上（其余位置 `continue`）；(2) 若单元格已经跨过了网格里**全部** fr 列且区域宽度有限，则干脆不撑宽 auto 列——fr 列分红后自然会腾出空间给它。这两条规则对应的测试就在 [`colspan.typ` 的 grid-colspan-over-all-fr-columns 等用例](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/colspan.typ#L92-L116)。

fr 分红：

[`grow_fractional_columns` 与 `Fr::share`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1101-L1112)——每条 fr 列分得 `v.share(fr, remaining)`，[`share` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/fr.rs#L56-L63) 就是上面的比例公式，`remaining.max(Abs::zero())` 保证负余量不分倒扣。

公平收缩：

[`shrink_auto_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1114-L1145)——`while changed && overlarge > 0` 循环不断剔除不需要收缩的列并重算 `fair`，末尾把所有 `rcol > fair` 的 auto 列钳到 `fair`。注释原文「Redistribute space to auto columns so that each gets a fair share」正是文档里「auto 轨道公平分配可用空间」承诺的落点。

行方向的派发在主循环里：

[`layout_row_internal` 按行轨道类型派发](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L425-L464)——`Sizing::Auto` 走 `layout_auto_row`（先测量后正式布局，可跨区域断开续排）、`Sizing::Rel` 走 `layout_relative_row`、`Sizing::Fr` 只是把 `Row::Fr(v, y, disambiguator)` 压进当前区域（[L452-L457](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L446-L458)），等 `finish_region` 收尾时才知道实际高度——与 u4-l4 里 flow 对 `fr` 间距的处理如出一辙。`Row` 枚举（[L214-L224](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L214-L224)）因此分 `Frame`（已完成的行）与 `Fr`（待分红的行）两态。

整场谈判的调度者是 [`GridLayouter::layout` 主循环](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L313-L388)：先 `measure_columns` 定列宽，再处理重复表脚预留、逐行推进（跳过表头区间、遇到 footer 布局表脚）、收尾区域、补排遗漏的 rowspan，最后 `render_fills_strokes` 补线与背景。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：手工推算一张混合轨道表格的列宽，再用现成测试验证推算。

现成测试 [`grid-columns-sizings-rect`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/grid.typ#L3-L20) 用了 `#set page(width: 100pt)` 与 `columns: (auto, 1fr, 3fr, 0.25cm, 3%, 2mm + 10%)`，auto 列两个单元格分别宽 `0.5cm` 与 `1cm`。

按 `measure_columns` 的议程手算（换算 \(1\,\text{cm} = 72/2.54 \approx 28.35\,\text{pt}\)，\(2\,\text{mm} \approx 5.67\,\text{pt}\)，百分比基准 = 页宽 100pt）：

\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{rel} &= 7.09 + 3 + (5.67 + 10) = 25.76\,\text{pt} \\
\text{available} &= 100 - 25.76 = 74.24\,\text{pt} \\
\text{auto} &= \max(14.17,\ 28.35) = 28.35\,\text{pt} \\
\text{remaining} &= 74.24 - 28.35 = 45.89\,\text{pt} \\
1\text{fr} &= 45.89 \times \tfrac{1}{4} \approx 11.47\,\text{pt},\quad 3\text{fr} \approx 34.42\,\text{pt}
\end{aligned}
\]

操作步骤：

1. 先写下你自己的推算结果；
2. 运行 `cargo testit grid-columns-sizings-rect` 确认测试通过；

4. 再做反向实验：把列改成 `columns: (auto, auto)`、页宽保持 100pt，两个单元格各塞一段 80pt 宽的文本，触发 `shrink_auto_columns`——观察两列是否被压到接近 50pt 的公平宽度。

**需要观察的现象**：fr 列宽度严格按 1:3 分红；auto 超载时两条 auto 列收缩后近似等宽。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`columns: (60pt, 1fr)`、页宽 100pt、只有一个空单元格，1fr 列多宽？

> **答案**：rel = 60pt，available = 40pt；auto 列不存在，auto 总量为 0；remaining = 40pt ≥ 0，唯一 fr 列分得全部 40pt。（`Fr::share` 中 \(1/1 \times 40 = 40\)。）

**练习 2**：三个 auto 列测量出 50pt、30pt、20pt，available 只有 60pt，最终各多宽？

> **答案**：`shrink_auto_columns`：初算 fair = 60/3 = 20pt，20pt 的列不超标被剔除（还给池子 20pt），剩 2 列分 40pt → fair = 20pt，30 与 50 仍超标、无新剔除，循环稳定；最终两列压到 20pt，原 20pt 列不变——结果 (20pt, 20pt, 20pt)。注意这个算法下「恰好等于 fair」的列不再参与挤压。

**练习 3**：为什么 `fr` 行不能像 `Rel` 行那样当场布局？

> **答案**：`fr` 的语义是「其他轨道分完之后的剩余空间」，而网格可能跨多个区域（页）：必须等当前区域里所有固定/自动行都排完、`finish_region` 时才知道剩余高度，才能给 `Row::Fr` 定高。这正是 `Row::Fr` 只登记不布局、推迟到收尾的原因（与 u4-l4 中 flow 对 fr 间距的延迟处理同构）。

### 4.3 模块三：列表复用——一段架构演进史

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

大纲给本模块起名「列表项复用网格的方式」。**这个说法描述的是历史版本，而当前 HEAD 已经不是这样了**——这本身就是极好的架构课：

- **旧设计（≈ 2026 年 5 月之前）**：`lists.rs` 里 `layout_list`/`layout_enum` 亲手构造一个两列 `CellGrid`（marker 列 + body 列），交给 `GridLayouter` 布局。列表 = 一种特殊的网格，复用整套 auto 轨道测量与跨页协商。
- **现设计**：提交 `b241417c4`（*Improved list layout (#7895)*，2026-05-27）重写为专用的 `ListLayouter` + `ItemLayouter`，每一项经 `StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter` 回调交给**栈布局**（`layout_stack_internal`）。

替换的直接动机是**基线对齐**：用户要求列表 marker（如 `1.`、`a)`）与正文第一行基线对齐（`number-align` / `marker-align`）。网格的行模型以「行框」为单位，表达不了「把 marker 下移 x pt，或把 body 重新排版并下移」这种非对称微调（见 4.3.3 的 `baseline_align`），于是列表走上了专用路径。

「复用网格」今天依然存在，只是搬了家：**文献目录（bibliography）**在 realize 阶段真的构造一个 `GridElem` 来排两栏文献条目；**table** 更是整个复用网格引擎（本讲 4.1）。所以准确的结论是：*通用引擎负责真正二维的场合，二维性很弱（两列、基线驱动）的列表退回专用实现。*

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

当前 `layout_items` 的四步流程（源码 doc comment 原文总结）：

```
1. measure_markers   —— 逐项试探布局 marker，取最大宽度（marker_width）
                        （这就是「auto 轨道测量」的迷你版！）
2. measure_bodies    —— 仅当区域宽度无限或 width: auto 时，测 body 最大宽度，
                        让各项在彼此之间对齐而不是对齐页宽
3. layout_item       —— 每项一个 ItemLayouter：排 marker、排 body、

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `measure_bodies` 只在「区域宽度无限或不可水平扩展」时执行？

> **答案**：宽度有限且可扩展时，列表会撑满可用宽度，各项 body 天然对齐同一边界，无需测量；只有 `width: auto`（无限宽度）或不可扩展的场合，栈布局不会把内容拉满，若不测量，各项 body 会各自为政、左边界参差（源码注释：prompting list items to align between themselves instead of relative to the full page width）。

**练习 2**：`baseline_align` 中为什么 `diff < 0` 分支要「重排 body」而 `diff ≥ 0` 分支只需移动 marker？

> **答案**：`diff ≥ 0` 说明 marker 基线在 body 之上，把 marker 向下平移即可，不改变任何尺寸；`diff < 0` 说明 marker 比正文首行低（如 marker 是高编号、body 首行是大号字），若只移动 body 会让列表项整体变高且与上方内容留缝，所以要用少了 `|diff|` 的空间**重新布局** body（可能因此多断一行），再整体下移——保证 marker 不侵入列表上方的内容。

**练习 3**：如果现在要给文献目录之外再实现一个「标签-内容」两栏结构（如术语表），应该模仿 bibliography 的做法还是 lists 的做法？

> **答案**：若两栏都是普通块级内容、需要跨页与行高协商——模仿 bibliography：构造 `GridElem`（两条 auto 列 + gutter）交给网格引擎；若右栏需要与左栏基线对齐这类**非对称微调**——模仿 lists 的专用布局器 + `StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter`。判据是「二维性是否退化到基线驱动的一维问题」。

### 4.4 模块四：数学排版结构——`MathItem`、`MathRun` 与分数/根式

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

数学排版与普通流式排版是两个世界：公式不是「块从上往下、字从左往右」的流，而是**嵌套盒子的递归组合**——分数把两个子公式上下摞、根式把 radicand 包进拉伸过的根号、矩阵把一堆公式排成阵列。Typst 把这套逻辑分成两层：

- **typst-library 的 `math::ir`**：`resolve_equation` 把求值后的公式内容解析成中间表示 `MathItem` 树（`MathKind::Fraction` / `Radical` / `Glyph` / `Table` 等 19 种，外加 `MathProperties` 携带数学类别、字号档位、左右间距等属性）；
- **typst-layout 的 `math` 模块**：`MathContext` 递归消费这棵树，每个节点产出一串 `MathFragment`（字形/子帧/空隙），同层的片段组成 `MathRun`（一行），按**基线**对齐拼进 `Frame`。

两个贯穿全模块的几何概念：

- **基线（baseline）**：帧内 y 坐标的一个刻度。同一行的所有片段按各自 ascent/descent 对齐到公共基线；分数、根式产出的复合帧也自带基线，于是能无限嵌套。
- **轴线（axis height）**：数学意义上的「公式竖直中心」，比基线略高（约半个 x 字高）。分数的横线、矩阵的整体基线都以轴为参照，来自字体 MATH 表的 `axis_height` 常量。

所有尺寸细节（分数线上移量、根号间隙、上下标缩放比例）都不是硬编码，而是**逐项查当前数学字体 OpenType MATH 表的常量**——这正是 Typst 换数学字体后排版感会变的原理。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

一个行内公式 $a/b + sqrt(x)$ 的完整旅程：

```
$ ... $ 源码
  │  typst-eval 求值出 EquationElem 的 body（内容树）
  │  行内: inline.rs 收集阶段把它作为 InlineItem 交给 math 模块（u4-l5 衔接点）
  ▼
resolve_equation (typst-library/src/math/ir/mod.rs)
  ▼
MathItem 树: Group[ Fraction(a,b) 的组件, Glyph(+), Radical(x) ... ]
  │  layout_equation_inline / layout_equation_block
  ▼
MathContext（携带字体栈与片段收集器）
  │  layout_into_self: 逐项 layout_realized，按 MathKind 派发：
  │    Fraction → layout_fraction（MATH 常量拼装，产出带基线的子帧）
  │    Radical  → layout_radical（拉伸根号 + 指数抬升）
  │    Table    → layout_table（矩阵：列内子列宽协商 + stack_rows）
  │    ...     → 其余 15 种
  ▼
MathRun = Vec<MathFragment>   （一行片段流）
  │  row_into_line_frame: y = row_ascent − frag.ascent()，全部落到公共基线
  │  行内公式再经 into_par_items: 在二元/关系运算符处切开 → 给段落断行机会
  ▼
Frame（带 baseline）→ 回到行内排版 / 块级 flow
```

行装配的核心不变式：一行里第 i 个片段的放置纵坐标为

\[ y_i = \text{row\_ascent} - \text{ascent}_i, \qquad \text{row\_ascent} = \max_i \text{ascent}_i \]

于是所有片段的基线恰好落在 `y = row_ascent` 这条水平线上。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

中间表示在 library 侧：

[`resolve_equation`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/math/ir/mod.rs#L19-L32)——入口只有几行：创建 `MathResolver`，把 `EquationElem.body` 解析进 arena 借用的 `MathItem`。顶层的 [`MathItem` 枚举](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/math/ir/item.rs#L65-L75) 只有四个变体：可布局组件 `Component`、显式 `Spacing`、普通空格 `Space`、内省 `Tag`。真正的分类在：

[`MathContext::layout_into_self`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/math/mod.rs#L438-L463)——遍历 `MathItem` 序列，若某项的字体设置与外层不同则压栈新字体（`fonts_stack`），保证局部换字体（如 `\frak`）只影响子树。单项派发在：

\[
\text{num\_gap} = \max\big(\text{shift\_up} - (\text{axis} + \tfrac{t}{2}) - \text{num.descent},\ \ \text{num\_min}\big)
\]

\[
\text{denom\_gap} = \max\big(\text{shift\_down} + (\text{axis} - \tfrac{t}{2}) - \text{denom.ascent},\ \ \text{denom\_min}\big)
